glosses: has been done (and left that way)
patterns.usage_note: Attaches to the te-form of what is almost always a transitive verb and reports the lingering result of something a person did on purpose, very often a preparation made in advance; the doer usually goes unmentioned, and the affected thing is marked が／は when the sentence describes the resulting state (窓が開けてある), and を when it reports the speaker's own advance preparation (切符はもう買ってある／切符をもう買ってある). Inserting a particle, as the headword てはある／てもある／てさえある does, turns the same frame into a concession or a point of emphasis. Contrast intransitive + ている (窓が開いている, a bare state) with transitive + てある (窓が開けてある, a state someone arranged).

examples.ruby: 会議用[かいぎよう]の資料[しりょう]は机[つくえ]の上[うえ]に置[お]いてある。
examples.english: The materials for the meeting are already set out on the desk.

examples.ruby: 壁[かべ]には去年[きょねん]のカレンダーが貼[は]ってあった。
examples.english: Last year's calendar was still up on the wall.

examples.ruby: 連絡[れんらく]はしてはあるが、返事[へんじ]がまだ来[こ]ない。
examples.english: I did get in touch with them, it's just that there's still no reply.
